entities.name: Codex Sinaiticus
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: One of the oldest nearly complete manuscripts of the Christian Bible, handwritten in Greek uncial script c. 330–360 CE. Discovered at Saint Catherine's Monastery on Mount Sinai, it contains the entire New Testament plus much of the Old Testament and is an indispensable witness for biblical textual criticism, preserving readings lost in later manuscripts.
